description.en: Compare eight whole-look moods through sixteen original visual choices. Read every highest-count full guide free, without a photo or face-type assignment.
description.zh: 通过十六次原创视觉选择，比较八种整体造型氛围。每个最高并列都有免费全文，无需照片，不分配面部类型。

resultHeading.en: Your style-choice counts and complete guides
resultHeading.zh: 你的造型选择次数与完整指南

introduction.en: Explore colours, accents and the mood of an imagined whole outfit. These eight original themes concern what you would like to try, not what your face looks like or which identity you should adopt. All eight complete guides are free before answering. The separate Outfit Line Preferences form explores five line-related agreement means; the scores do not convert.
introduction.zh: 探索想象中整套穿搭的颜色、点缀与氛围。八个原创主题关注愿意尝试什么，不判断面部外观或应该采用哪种身份。八篇全文均可作答前免费阅读。独立的服装线条偏好题本记录五项线条认同均值，分数不换算。

instructions.en: Answer for yourself about a look you would like to try today. Imagine the written descriptions; you do not need to own, wear or photograph anything. In each comparison choose the closest of four offered whole-look ideas. Other themes are absent from that comparison, not rejected. Choosing an option is a relative preference, not a claim that every detail fits you. If none is useful, you may leave and read all eight guides without answering. All sixteen choices are required before counts appear. Each theme appears eight times and twice in each position; one selection adds one raw count. Every highest tie opens in full, without a hidden secondary type, match percentage, face analysis or body classification. Practical fit, comfort, budget and dress codes need your separate judgement.
instructions.zh: 为自己评价今天愿意尝试的造型，想象文字描述即可，不必拥有、穿上或拍摄任何东西。每次从给出的四个整体构思里选较接近偏好的一项；当次未出现的主题不算被拒绝。选项表示相对偏好，不宣称每个细节都适合自己。如果描述都无用，可以离开，不作答也能读八篇全文。十六次选择完成后才显示次数。每主题出现八次，在每个位置各两次；选中一次记一次原始计数。每个最高并列都完整展开，不设隐藏副型、匹配百分比、面部分析或身体分类。真实合身、舒适、预算与着装规定需另由自己判断。

prompt.en: Imagine an optional afternoon outfit with no dress code. Which whole-look direction appeals most?

title.en: Soft Play: Whole-Look Style Preferences Guide
title.zh: 柔软玩心：整体造型氛围偏好完整指南

description.en: Explore this original style theme through palettes, outfit details, comparisons and a no-purchase experiment. Full guide free, without face or body classification.
description.zh: 从示例配色、穿搭细节、主题比较与无需购买的小尝试理解这一原创造型主题。全文免费，不作面部或身体分类。

title.en: The visual idea behind this theme
title.zh: 这一主题的视觉构思

paragraphs.en: Soft Play brings together a gentle background, rounded little shapes and a small note of visual amusement. The theme can be as simple as a tiny cloud-like motif on an otherwise plain combination. Its interest lies in the relationship between restraint and play: a detail can be cheerful without filling every part of the look. Choosing this description does not establish a youthful face, an affectionate personality or an obligation to dress in a particularly sweet way.
paragraphs.zh: 柔软玩心把轻柔背景、圆润小形状与一点视觉趣味放在一起。它可以简单到：在原本素净的组合上，加一个小云朵般的图案。重点是克制与玩心的关系，细节可以有趣，而不必填满整套造型。选中这类描述，不表示面部年轻、性格亲昵，也不要求穿得特别甜美。

title.en: An example palette and surface relationship
title.zh: 示例配色与表面关系

paragraphs.en: The example palette uses warm cream, soft pink, pale blue-grey and muted rose-brown. These are original colour examples, not a personal colour-season analysis. A small pink accent against cream may convey this theme without making the entire outfit pale. If you dislike pink, try a similarly quiet blue or another colour you already enjoy. What matters for the example is a gentle relationship between the background and the small rounded detail, rather than any supposedly compulsory colour.
paragraphs.zh: 示例使用暖米白、柔粉、浅蓝灰与柔和玫棕，这是原创配色举例，不是个人色彩季型分析。米白背景上的一点粉色，就可以表达这种构思，不需要全套浅色。不喜欢粉色，也可以换成同样安静的蓝色或你已有的喜爱颜色。示例关注背景与圆润小细节的柔和关系，没有任何规定必须使用的颜色。

title.en: How details set the whole-look mood
title.zh: 细节怎样影响整体氛围

paragraphs.en: Scale is useful to observe here. A modest rounded fastening, a small repeated shape or one whimsical accent may set the mood more clearly than a large decorative cluster. Repeating that accent once can connect separate pieces, but many repetitions may make the result busier than you intended. These are descriptions of visual arrangements, not measurements of the wearer. A small motif can appeal to someone of any height, age or gender, and its actual placement is a personal choice.
paragraphs.zh: 可以留意细节的尺度。一枚不大的圆扣、小小重复形状，或一处有趣点缀，就可能比大组装饰更清楚地定下氛围。呼应一次能连接不同单品，重复太多则可能比原先打算的更繁忙。这些描述针对视觉安排，不测量穿着者。任何身高、年龄或性别的人都可能喜欢小纹样，实际放在哪儿由自己选择。

title.en: One complete outfit idea to imagine
title.zh: 想象一个完整造型

paragraphs.en: Imagine a plain cream top, a simple neutral lower piece and one small rounded accessory in a colour you like. The playful detail is the part to notice; the surrounding pieces give it room. You could instead make the accent a familiar button or a little motif already present on an item you own. The example is complete as a visual idea without specifying a body shape, a shopping list, a required haircut or a rule about which person should wear it.
paragraphs.zh: 想象一件素净米白上衣、简单中性色下装，再加一个自己喜欢颜色的小圆润配饰。值得留意的是那一点趣味，周围单品为它留出空间。也可以把重点换成已有衣物上的熟悉纽扣或小纹样。这个例子作为视觉构思已经完整，不需要指定身体形状、购物清单、固定发型，或规定哪种人才能穿。

title.en: Compare neighbouring themes without a fixed label
title.zh: 比较相近主题，不固定标签

paragraphs.en: Compare Soft Play with Colour Play by changing only the accent’s size or saturation in your imagination. A tiny quiet motif and a large bright graphic may both be playful, but they create different amounts of visual emphasis. Compare it with Flowing Detail by replacing the compact motif with a fine decorative line that trails across a surface. Neither neighbouring theme is a better version of this one. Similar counts may simply mean that more than one kind of playful or soft detail interests you.
paragraphs.zh: 想象只改变点缀的大小或饱和度，就能比较柔软玩心与跳色玩趣。安静小纹样与明亮大图形都可以有趣，但视觉重点的分量不同。再把小纹样换成沿表面延伸的纤细装饰线，可与柔和点缀比较。相近主题没有谁更高级；次数接近，可能只是你对不止一种玩心或柔和细节有兴趣。

title.en: A small experiment using what you have
title.zh: 利用已有物品做一个小尝试

paragraphs.en: For a small experiment, lay out an existing plain combination and add one rounded detail you already have. Compare the arrangement with and without it. Notice whether you enjoy the detail itself, the lighter overall mood or the contrast with the plain background. You can make a private written note rather than take a photograph. Keep, move or remove the detail according to your own preference; there is no need to complete an entire themed wardrobe or persuade yourself to like the result.

Try thinking about two neighbouring shades with a fine pattern linking them, then compare a clearer separation between the same shades. A floral suggestion is one possible detail, not a requirement or a statement about romance. These examples were written for the guide and have not been selected through a personal skin-colour, face or body assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 柔和玫粉、灰紫、柔沙色与浅象牙色，提供一种想象柔和过渡的配色，不需要同时全部出现。可以先想两种相近色由细纹样串联，再比较同色之间分隔较清楚的版本。花意象只是可能的细节，不是规定，也不代表爱情倾向。示例为本指南原创，没有经过针对皮肤颜色、面部或身体的个人评估。

title.en: How details set the whole-look mood
title.zh: 细节怎样影响整体氛围

paragraphs.en: Consider where a decorative line begins and ends, how often it repeats and whether the surrounding area gives it enough room. A small curved accessory can echo a pattern without exactly copying it. Too many fine details may compete with the movement you wanted to notice, but whether that feels appealing is still your choice. Delicate describes the apparent scale of a cue; it does not establish that the item is expensive, fragile, comfortable or better made than a plainer alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 可以留意装饰线从哪里开始、在哪里结束、重复几次，以及周围是否为它留出空间。小弧形配饰能与纹样呼应，而不必完全复制。太多细节可能互相争夺注意，但喜欢这种繁复与否仍由你选择。“纤细”描述线索的视觉尺度，不证明物品昂贵、脆弱、舒适，或比朴素款式制作更好。

title.en: One complete outfit idea to imagine
title.zh: 想象一个完整造型

paragraphs.en: Imagine a softly patterned piece with a plain neutral item beside it and one small curved detail repeating part of the pattern’s movement. The complete idea comes from the relationship among those pieces, not from a required neckline, hairstyle or body contour. You can make the decorative area smaller if you prefer a quieter version. You can also enjoy a fine winding line in an imagined outfit without wanting to own the material, wear it daily or make it your signature style.
paragraphs.zh: 想象一件柔纹单品，旁边配素净中性色，再用一个小弧形细节呼应纹样的部分走向。完整构思来自单品关系，不依赖规定领口、发型或身体曲线。喜欢较安静的版本，可以缩小装饰区域；也可以仅欣赏想象穿搭中的细小蜿蜒线条，而不想拥有这种材质、每天穿它，或把它固定成个人标志。

title.en: Compare neighbouring themes without a fixed label
title.zh: 比较相近主题，不固定标签

paragraphs.en: Soft Play often uses a compact, gently amusing motif, while Flowing Detail puts more emphasis on decorative movement and fine transitions. Quiet Polish may share muted colours, but its examples generally keep the finish less decorative and more evenly restrained. A person can enjoy all three in different settings. Rather than asking which label is correct, compare the actual cues: a small rounded symbol, a trailing line or a discreetly repeated finish. Those concrete differences are more informative than the theme name alone.
paragraphs.zh: 柔软玩心常用小巧、轻松有趣的纹样，柔和点缀则更强调装饰走向与纤细过渡。安静细致也可能用柔和颜色，但示例收尾通常较少装饰、较均匀克制。同一个人可以在不同情境喜欢三者。不妨比较实际线索：小圆润符号、延伸线条，或低调重复收尾；这些具体差别，比单看名称更有信息。

title.en: A small experiment using what you have
title.zh: 利用已有物品做一个小尝试

paragraphs.en: Use an existing patterned item, a familiar curved accessory or a simple paper sketch to try one fine decorative echo. Compare the idea with a plain version and with a version that repeats the detail more often. Notice whether the pattern, the soft transition or the amount of repetition appeals most. You may keep only one small element from the experiment. There is no need to buy delicate fabrics, adopt an occasion-based wardrobe or explain your personality through the result.
paragraphs.zh: 可以用已有纹样单品、熟悉弧形配饰，或简单纸上草图，试一处细腻装饰呼应。与素净版本、重复更多次的版本比较，留意最喜欢的是纹样、柔和过渡，还是重复的分量。最后只保留一个小元素也可以，不需要购买纤细织物、改成某种场合衣橱，或用结果解释自己的性格。

title.en: Read the counts and every highest tie
title.zh: 阅读次数与每个最高并列

paragraphs.en: Each theme appears in eight of the sixteen four-way comparisons, twice in each option position. A selected option adds one count to its theme. Eight appearances do not mean that every comparison asks the same question or offers the same alternatives. For example, three selections mean three choices among the offered descriptions, not a 37.5 percent match with your face or personality. The result opens every theme sharing the highest count in full. No hidden rule breaks a tie, and nearby counts do not establish an officially meaningful primary or secondary type.
paragraphs.zh: 十六次四选一比较中，每个主题出现八次，在每个选项位置各两次。选中某个描述，就为其主题记一次。八次出现不表示每次问题或对照选项相同。例如，选中三次，只表示在所给描述中作了三次这种选择，不是你的面部或人格有37.5%的匹配。所有最高次数并列的主题都完整展开，不用隐藏规则拆开并列；相近次数也不构成官方意义的主型或副型。

title.en: Keep preference, practical fit and identity separate
title.zh: 区分偏好、实际合适与身份

paragraphs.en: Use the descriptions as optional styling ideas. This original edition does not inspect a photograph, facial proportions, age, gender, skin undertone or body frame. Its eight names describe combinations of visual cues rather than the eight categories in a professional face-feature system. It cannot determine what will fit, feel comfortable, meet a dress code or look attractive to somebody else. Those practical decisions remain yours. Changing your mind, borrowing a detail from another guide or deciding that none of these descriptions is useful does not require a new personal label.
paragraphs.zh: 把这些描述当成可选的造型构思。本原创版本不查看照片、面部比例、年龄、性别、皮肤底调或身体框架。八个名称描述视觉线索组合，不是专业面部特征体系中的八种类别。它不能确定衣服是否合身、舒服、符合着装规定，或是否令别人觉得好看；这些实际判断仍由你作出。改变主意、借用另一篇的细节，或认为这些描述都无用，都不需要换一个个人标签。

title.en: The visual idea behind this theme
title.zh: 这一主题的视觉构思

paragraphs.en: Quiet Polish groups close colour relationships, discreet repeated details and an evenly finished arrangement. The idea is not to hide every feature but to let small connections become noticeable without one large accent taking over. The word polish describes the visual finish imagined in these options. It does not measure grooming habits, reliability, sophistication or the price of a wardrobe. A preference for these descriptions can coexist with interest in bright colours, rough textures or more decorative choices elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 安静细致把相近颜色关系、低调重复细节与均匀收尾组合起来。构思并不是藏起所有特点，而是让小联系被看见，同时不由某个大点缀接管整体。“细致”描述选项里想象的视觉收尾，不测量打理习惯、可靠性、修养或衣橱价格。喜欢这些描述，也可以同时对亮色、粗粝纹理或其他更有装饰感的选择感兴趣。

paragraphs.en: Muted taupe, pale stone, soft grey and warm off-white form one example palette. Their closeness can make a small variation in texture or sheen easier to notice. Neutrals are examples, not a compulsory uniform, and low contrast has no automatic connection with quality or social standing. The guide does not know your personal colouring and cannot declare that these shades flatter your face.

title.zh: 细节怎样影响整体氛围

paragraphs.en: Watch how small details relate across an outfit. A repeated colour in a fastening and another small area may create a quiet link without requiring an exact matching set. Similar-scale details can hold attention evenly, while one much larger feature may change the emphasis. A carefully finished visual idea can use ordinary, familiar pieces. Words such as neat or polished in this guide refer to the described arrangement; they are not judgements about the wearer’s discipline, taste or ability to organise daily life.
paragraphs.zh: 可以看小细节怎样跨越整套穿搭发生联系。扣饰与另一小块区域重复同色，就能形成安静联系，不必完全配套。尺度相近的细节可以平均分配注意，一个大得多的元素则会改变重点。细致的视觉构思可以使用普通熟悉单品。文中的整洁、细致针对描述中的安排，不评价穿着者的自律、品位或日常组织能力。

title.zh: 想象一个完整造型

paragraphs.en: Imagine a familiar top and lower piece in neighbouring tones, with one small accent that softly repeats a colour already present. Add a plain layer only if it helps connect the arrangement. The result can remain very ordinary in use; no special occasion or expensive material is implied. Compare a smooth surface with a quietly textured one while leaving the colours unchanged. That comparison helps separate an interest in close tones from an interest in a particular finish or type of decoration.
paragraphs.zh: 想象熟悉的上衣与下装采用相近色调，再用小点缀柔和呼应已有颜色。只有当素净外层能帮助连接整体时，才加入它；使用场景可以非常日常，不暗示特殊场合或昂贵材质。保持颜色不变，比较平滑与低调纹理表面，就能区分喜欢相近色调，还是喜欢某种收尾或装饰。

title.en: Compare neighbouring themes without a fixed label
title.zh: 比较相近主题，不固定标签

paragraphs.en: Light Ease can share an uncluttered arrangement, but it highlights an open, light-looking relationship between a few straightforward cues. Quiet Polish gives more attention to close tones, small repetitions and discreet finish. Formal Poise may be carefully coordinated too, yet its examples make the intentional, occasion-ready arrangement more visible. You do not need to choose one theme for every day. Different comparisons may reveal that you like a quiet palette in one setting and a more deliberate focal point in another.
paragraphs.zh: 轻快自在也可以简洁，但更强调少量直接线索之间开放、轻浅的关系。安静细致更关注相近色调、小重复与低调收尾。端整仪式也可能认真协调，但示例会更清楚地显出有意准备、适合某个场合的构思。不需要每天只选一个主题；不同对照可能说明，你在某情境喜欢安静配色，在另一情境想要更明确焦点。

title.en: A small experiment using what you have
title.zh: 利用已有物品做一个小尝试

paragraphs.en: Choose two items you already know and identify one small colour or shape that could connect them. Try a modest repetition, then remove it and compare the overall impression. If the first version feels too uniform, introduce one different surface or a slightly clearer accent. A private sketch or a short note is sufficient; no photograph, purchase or wardrobe replacement is required. Keep the element that is useful to you rather than treating a quiet finish as a standard you must maintain.
paragraphs.zh: 选两件熟悉物品，找一种能连接它们的小颜色或形状。试着少量重复，再拿掉，比较整体印象。如果第一个版本太一致，就加入一种不同表面或稍清楚的点缀。私人草图或简短笔记就够，不需要照片、购物或换衣橱。保留对自己有用的元素即可，不把安静收尾变成必须维持的标准。

title.en: The visual idea behind this theme
title.zh: 这一主题的视觉构思

paragraphs.en: Formal Poise groups a deliberately coordinated whole, clearly placed accents and a finish that looks intentionally complete. A small ordinary outfit can express the idea through one repeated detail; it does not need to be ceremonial clothing. The word formal names a visual direction, not a judgement of manners, confidence or social competence. Choosing it does not make you more mature, authoritative or prepared for a particular role, and choosing another theme does not diminish any of those qualities.
paragraphs.zh: 端整仪式把有意协调的整体、位置清楚的点缀与完整收尾组合起来。一套普通小穿搭，也能通过一个重复细节表达这种构思，不需要礼服。“仪式”命名视觉方向，不评价礼貌、自信或社交能力。选中它，不让人更成熟、更有权威或更适合某个角色；选择其他主题，也不会减损这些品质。

title.en: An example palette and surface relationship
title.zh: 示例配色与表面关系

paragraphs.en: Deep navy, muted rose-grey, pale parchment and soft dark brown provide one palette for imagining an organised contrast. A darker area can frame a lighter focal detail, or a repeated accent can connect separate pieces. These examples are not instructions for a workplace, wedding or other event. An actual dress code needs to be checked separately. You can use a different colour family while keeping the idea of an intentional set, and no shade is presented as a universal marker of elegance.
paragraphs.zh: 深海军蓝、柔和玫灰、浅纸色与柔和深棕，提供一种有组织对比的配色。深色区域可以衬出浅色焦点，也可以通过重复点缀连接单品。这不是针对办公室、婚礼或其他活动的着装指令，真实规定需要另行确认。换成其他色系也能保留有意成套的构思，没有哪种颜色被当作普遍优雅的标志。

title.en: How details set the whole-look mood
title.zh: 细节怎样影响整体氛围

paragraphs.en: Consider whether a focal detail sits centrally, whether two accents echo one another and how the arrangement reaches its finish. Symmetry is one possible device, but exact mirroring is not essential. One side can carry more detail while the rest of the outfit provides a clear relationship to it. A substantial-looking accent is a matter of visual scale, not a request to buy heavy jewellery or uncomfortable clothing. Its actual weight, movement and suitability remain separate practical decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 可以留意焦点是否居中、两处点缀是否呼应，以及整体怎样收尾。对称是一种办法，但不要求完全镜像；一边细节较多，另一边也能通过清楚关系回应。有分量感的点缀说的是视觉尺度，不要求购买沉重首饰或不舒服的衣服。真实重量、活动与是否适合，仍要另作实际决定。

title.en: One complete outfit idea to imagine
title.zh: 想象一个完整造型

paragraphs.en: Imagine a plain familiar outfit with one existing outer layer and a small coordinated accent. Repeat a colour or shape once so that the pieces seem deliberately connected. The look can feel more occasion-like without changing every item or adding expensive materials. Now imagine moving the accent away from the centre or removing the repeated detail. Comparing those versions can show whether you enjoy the organised whole, the focal point or simply the particular colour you chose for the experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 想象一套素净熟悉的衣服，配一件已有外层和一个协调小点缀。重复一次颜色或形状，让单品显得有意相连，不必替换所有衣物或加入昂贵材质，就能比较更有场合感的构思。再想象把重点移离中心，或拿掉重复细节，比较喜欢的是有组织的整体、焦点本身，还是尝试里选中的那种颜色。

title.en: Compare neighbouring themes without a fixed label
title.zh: 比较相近主题，不固定标签

paragraphs.en: Quiet Polish may be equally coordinated but keeps the connections more discreet and the contrast lower in its examples. Clean Edge puts more emphasis on a precise line or graphic boundary and can be much more spare. Formal Poise is distinguished here by the visibly intentional relationship across the whole arrangement. You can borrow a crisp line or a quiet palette without having to switch identities. If themes tie, their complete guides remain available side by side rather than being blended into a new, unsupported personal category.
paragraphs.zh: 安静细致可能同样协调，但示例联系更低调、对比较弱。简洁锐线更强调清楚线条或图形边界，可以非常简省。端整仪式在这里的区别，是整个安排之间可见的有意联系。可以借一条利落线或一组安静颜色，不必转换身份。主题并列时，各篇完整指南并排保留，不混合成一个没有依据的新个人类别。

title.en: A small experiment using what you have

paragraphs.en: Use an ordinary set of clothes as the starting point and add one small visual connection between two areas. Compare a clearly centred version with a looser arrangement. You may discover that one little echo creates enough of an intentional finish, or that you prefer the less coordinated version. Either outcome is useful. This exercise asks what you enjoy trying, not how successfully you satisfy somebody else’s expectations. It needs no purchase, public presentation or commitment to dressing formally in everyday life.
paragraphs.zh: 从普通衣物组合出发，在两个区域加一处小联系，比较焦点明确居中的版本与较松散的安排。可能发现一点呼应就足够，也可能更喜欢不那么成套的版本，两种观察都有用。尝试关注愿意试什么，不检查是否成功满足别人期待；不需要购物、公开展示，或承诺日常都采用正式着装。

The detail can be a bold graphic or a colour that appears again in an unusual place. A higher count does not mean that you are more extroverted, confident or eager for attention. It records choices among descriptions in this edition. title.en: How details set the whole-look mood

paragraphs.en: Think about the size and spacing of the accent as well as its colour. A large playful motif, a small repeated pop and two contrasting blocks can create different rhythms. A quieter background may make the accent easy to read, while several bright areas may create the busier effect you enjoy. Neither arrangement is inherently better. Playfulness names a quality of the visual idea, not an age category or a judgement about how seriously a person approaches life or work.
paragraphs.zh: 除了颜色，也可以留意点缀的大小与间距。放大趣味纹样、小面积重复跳色，以及两个对比色块，会形成不同节奏。安静背景能让点缀清楚，几处明亮区域也可能形成你喜欢的繁忙效果，两者没有天然高低。“玩趣”描述视觉构思的性质，不是年龄类别，也不评价一个人对生活或工作的认真程度。

You may prefer the first version because it feels connected, or the second because the contrast feels more playful. The example leaves the actual cut, comfort and occasion requirements to your own practical judgement.
paragraphs.zh: 想象一套简单中性色组合，放一处亮色细节，再在别处小小呼应一次。同色可能已存在于熟悉单品里，不需要新购；也可以把颜色呼应换成对比图形，比较整体氛围。可能因联系清楚而喜欢第一种，也可能因碰撞有趣而喜欢第二种。例子把真实剪裁、舒适度与场合要求，留给你实际判断。

paragraphs.en: Soft Play uses amusement too, but its examples tend toward compact rounded motifs and a gentler emphasis. Colour Play makes the contrast or visual scale more noticeable. Clean Edge may share a strong graphic boundary while keeping the palette and arrangement more spare. paragraphs.en: Take one existing bright or patterned item and imagine it in two simple whole-outfit arrangements. In one, let it be the only clear accent; in the other, add a small echo or a deliberate contrast. Compare the versions privately and note which detail changes the mood for you. You can use a rough sketch if you do not want to wear the combination. A useful trial may end with keeping just one colour relationship, without buying more items or adopting a constantly bright public image.

paragraphs.en: Matte charcoal, muted grey-green, warm stone and pale sand-grey offer one possible palette. These examples do not imply that darker shades suit everyone or that rough-looking surfaces are more authentic. Colour and surface relationships are visual possibilities, while actual personal colouring and garment performance remain unmeasured.

paragraphs.en: Notice the relationship between a loose outline and a visible fastening, straight metallic accent or firm dark boundary. One clearly placed detail may be enough to keep an easy arrangement from looking visually diffuse. A raw-looking texture is a description of appearance, not a promise about durability, comfort or the way a fabric touches skin. You may enjoy the image but dislike the actual material. That distinction is useful information about the difference between imagined visual preference and real-world use.

No particular material, brand or item of clothing is necessary to understand the idea. paragraphs.en: Clean Edge may share the defined dark detail, but its examples usually keep the surface smoother and the graphic arrangement more controlled. Light Ease can share casual simplicity while using lighter, more open cues. Formal Poise places more emphasis on an intentionally coordinated whole. A detail from any of these neighbours can be combined with a relaxed layer if that appeals to you. Comparing the actual cues is more useful than deciding which theme is your permanent or most authentic style.

answer.zh: 不是。这里观察原创的整体造型偏好，不检查面部、照片、身体、年龄或性别，也没有使用或复制官方八型评估。

answer.en: Yes. All eight complete guides are free before answering. Every highest-count guide is shown in full after a complete attempt, with no signup or purchase.
answer.zh: 免费。八篇全文在作答前已开放，完整作答后每个最高并列也全文显示，无需注册或购买。

question.en: How do the sixteen choices become counts?
question.zh: 十六次选择怎样成为次数？

answer.en: Choose one of four descriptions for every comparison. Each theme appears eight times, twice in each position. A chosen description adds one count; the eight counts sum to sixteen and are not a match percentage or personality total.
answer.zh: 每次四个描述选一项。每主题出现八次、每位置各两次，选中一次记一次。八项次数之和为十六，不是匹配百分比或人格总分。

answer.en: Every theme sharing the highest count receives its complete eight-section guide. No hidden rule chooses a sole winner or assigns a secondary type. All other public guides remain free to compare.
answer.zh: 每个最高次数并列主题都有完整八节指南，不用隐藏规则选唯一赢家或分配副型，其他公开全文仍可免费比较。

question.en: What if none of the descriptions is useful?

answer.en: You may leave without completing the form and read any full guide. Partial attempts do not produce counts. A completed choice only means closest among those four alternatives, not absolute endorsement of every detail.
answer.zh: 可以不完成题本就离开，并阅读任意全文。未完成不生成次数。完整选择也只表示当次四个对照里较接近偏好，不是绝对认同所有细节。

answer.en: Answers stay in the current page memory, without a stored draft, quiz-flow statistics or personal-result sharing. Refreshing, changing language or leaving loses the attempt. Public guides contain no one’s answers or counts.
answer.zh: 答案只留当前页面内存，不存草稿、不发送测试流程统计、不分享个人结果。刷新、换语言或离开会丢失；公开指南不含任何人的答案或次数。
